title: Mandate 83: the ten agent operating rules; Mandate 82 becomes a cadence
goal: Vision: V-8. CEO directive 2026-11-16, ten rules for every agent. Record them as CEO Mandate 83 (constitution entry, docs/ceo-mandate-83.md, AGENTS.md section and table row, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, README list, self-build contract), rewrite Mandate 82 to the CEO's amended wording (commit, push, merge and pull about every ten minutes, a cadence and not a hard limit, meaningfully), amend Mandate 76 (asking never means waiting; a claim past its lease is open), and guard all of it with the governance tests. The tool changes are in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (its T-CLAUDEMANDATE83-1).

reuse.searched: What core already says for each of the ten rules: Mandates 49, 62, 65, 72 to 82, AGENTS.md (isolation, board, credentials through susi keys vault), the self-build contract (crates/susi-core/src/self_build.rs), the harness launch profiles (crates/susi-harness/src/adaptive.rs: full-permission engine flags by default, a governed profile beside them) and the governance guards (tests/architecture_tests.rs, tests/agent_bootstrap.rs). The mandate points to the mandate that carries each rule and adds only what is new; the workflow tool that makes rules 3, 6 and 7 real is changed in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (its T-CLAUDEMANDATE83-1). No new code path, dependency or harvest in core.

limitations: Core carries the rules, their documents, the self-build contract clauses and the governance tests. Claim leases, the ten-minute measurement and board access are in the workflow tool in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps.
Rules 1, 2, 4 and 10 are conduct the tool cannot see. The one-hour claim lease is the implementing agent's choice of number; the CEO named none.
Rule 9 records how agents are run. Nothing in core's harness was changed: its default engine commands already use each tool's full-permission flag and its governed profile is untouched.
Main is unqualified development, not a release.
